caption: The drawing features two overlapping rectangular pieces of cloth rendered in fine brown ink on a light, almost cream-colored background. The visible piece on top is slightly folded, with the folded corner displaying both the front and back of the cloth. Each cloth has an ornate border composed of a wavy band embellished with repeated feather-like and leaf motifs forming a scalloped edge. Near the center of the cloth, there are two circular rosette decorations, each filled with intricate patterns of leaves and small floral elements. The fabric appears transparent or thin due to the faintness of the inner lines, and the overall arrangement is flat with delicate detailing emphasizing the decorative elements. In the lower right corner, the name "J.M. Burge.36." is inscribed in small print.
title: Neckerchief
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
